home.description: Auto home. Sends the arm to its home position.

jog-y-positive.description: Moves the end-effector one selected step in the positive Y direction.

jog-x-negative.description: Moves the end-effector one selected step in the negative X direction.

jog-x-positive.description: Moves the end-effector one selected step in the positive X direction.

jog-y-negative.description: Moves the end-effector one selected step in the negative Y direction.

move-up.description: Moves the lift upward along Z by the selected linear step.

move-down.description: Moves the lift downward along Z by the selected linear step.

wrist-left.description: Rotates the wrist in the negative E direction by the selected wrist step.

wrist-right.description: Rotates the wrist in the positive E direction by the selected wrist step.

direct-stepper.description: Direct stepper move. Moves shoulder A, elbow B, or lift C directly.

open-gripper.description: Moves servo P0 to the open gripper angle.

close-gripper.description: Moves servo P0 to the closed gripper angle.

servo-bounds.description: Sets the min and max bounds for servo P0.

detach-servo.description: Detaches servo P0 by cutting the PWM signal. Useful to avoid idle buzzing or heating.

get-position.description: Reports the current X, Y, Z, and E coordinates.

check-endstops.description: Reports the current state of the limit switches as open or TRIGGERED.

enable-motors.description: Enables the stepper motors and locks them in place.

disable-motors.description: Disables the stepper motors so the arm can be moved manually.

emergency-stop.description: Emergency stop. Hard halt that shuts down the board and requires a reset.
